task.title: Creating an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Earnings to be allocated: Leave this field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “Adjustment to EI ERB claim required.”

Remarks line 2–4: Type the appropriate details:
If there is a W allocation on file, type “Rescind W allocation $[XXXX], w/c [XXXX].”
If necessary, type “[Add, modify, or rescind] D47 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
If necessary, type “Remove the FWW or found work code in w/c [XXXX].”
Type “Apply UP to OP,” if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: Determine if the client must be notified of a disentitlement:
In ACS, create and send the C-71-05-01 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Earnings / insurable hours of work / income while on claim (12577)

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the C-74-01-13 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Choice of phrases decision letter to claimant (12610): Select the appropriate option.
Since we have not received a response from you / After reviewing your response (12612)

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Report for Investigation (IC70) screen, select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li:
Overpayment: Select OP .
Reason: Select Other .
Amount: Enter the OP.

Reason: Select Other and type the appropriate option:
“EI ERB eligibility not proven — D47 imposed from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].” .
“EI ERB eligibility proven — D47 not imposed.”.

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity - ERB Reason for separation WI.
